research_question: What determines unit performance in these firms, and in particular how does the decentralization of operating decisions affect unit performance, through which mechanisms, and under what conditions?

variables.name: decision_decentralization
variables.label: Share of operating decisions delegated from headquarters to the unit (standardized index)

variables.name: unit_performance
variables.label: Unit operating performance relative to plan (standardized index)

variables.name: environmental_turbulence
variables.label: Volatility of demand and competitive conditions in the unit's market (standardized index)

variables.name: local_knowledge_use
variables.label: Extent to which unit decisions draw on local customer and market information, from decision audits (standardized index)

variables.name: coordination_cost
variables.label: Managerial time and rework spent reconciling the unit's decisions with other units (standardized index)

variables.name: it_integration
variables.label: Degree of integration of the unit's information systems with headquarters systems (standardized index)

variables.name: unit_size
variables.label: Number of employees in the unit (standardized index)

variables.name: managerial_experience
variables.label: Average years of managerial experience in the unit leadership team (standardized index)

variables.name: hq_attention
variables.label: Attention headquarters devotes to the unit, from meeting and review logs (standardized index)

variables.name: formal_planning_hours
variables.label: Hours the unit spends on formal strategic planning (standardized index)

variables.name: market_concentration
variables.label: Concentration of the unit's market (standardized index)

literature.design: Panel of 418 business units in 37 multi-unit firms.
literature.mechanism: Delegation is argued to put decisions where the relevant knowledge sits.

literature.design: Survey of 265 units matched to market volatility data.
literature.mechanism: Decentralized units are argued to adapt faster when conditions change.
The authors recommend formal planning routines.

literature.design: Decision-audit study of 1,900 decisions in 84 units.
Time-use study of 140 unit management teams.
